prompt:
Our bioinformatics team has a local research workspace at `/workspace` that contains pipeline configs, QC reports, and computational results we need to keep backed up to a version-controlled remote repository. The workspace already has a sync automation script available, but the backup has never been run because the environment isn't fully set up yet.

A mock remote repository has been initialized at the path stored in `/tmp/mock_remote_path.txt`.

Please do whatever is necessary to make the automated backup script run successfully end-to-end and push the workspace content to that remote repository. The workspace also has some very large model checkpoint files that should NOT be included in version control — the backup tooling is supposed to handle this automatically.

The goal is a clean, successful sync with all workspace files (except oversized ones) committed and pushed to the remote.
